summary: Brown & Brown, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on June 5, 2026. This replaces the prior credit agreement, increasing the revolving facility from $800M to $1.25B with maturity extended to June 5, 2031, and adding $250M Term A-1 Loan (2029 maturity) and $250M Term A-2 Loan (2031 maturity). $825M was outstanding at filing. This is a routine refinancing to enhance liquidity and extend maturities, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or disputed management change.
